scene.title: Understanding 3/4 of a pizza
scene.summary: A pizza is divided into four equal slices; three of them represent three quarters.

beats.title: Whole pizza
beats.narration: Here is a whole pizza, shown as a circle.

beats.title: Divide into quarters
beats.narration: We cut the pizza into four equal slices.

beats.title: Three quarters
beats.narration: Three of the four slices together make three quarters of the pizza.

beats.title: Fraction notation
beats.narration: We write this amount as the fraction 3/4.
